name: B10-0396/2025 (ECR) – Detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the arrest of five Greek Cypriot citizens who are also EU citizens. They were detained on 19 July 2025 by the Turkish authorities in the occupied north of Cyprus after crossing the Strovilia checkpoint. The text demands their immediate and unconditional release and says their health has worsened without proper care. It also calls for Turkey to be held accountable and for the Green Line rules to be revised or even repealed.

- The text asks for the five detainees to be freed at once; it does not itself change any law.
- It concerns the five EU citizens held in the occupied north of Cyprus.
- It calls on the Council and Commission to act against Turkey and review the Green Line rules.
